## Workload

Nadia Qureshi recorded 1016 reads during 480 hours of grading activity. This represents an average of 2.1 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed in the context of the available grading time and the volume completed.

## Quality

A sample of 89 reads was checked as part of the quality review. Agreement was 74.2 per cent. The review also considered borderline background cases and provided feedback where required.

Priya Anand completed the review. The workload and quality findings should be considered together: the record shows the volume assessed, the time recorded, the sample checked, and the resulting level of agreement.
